en.headline: Police arrest 10 in crackdown on fake concert ticket syndicate
en.dek: Officers detained six men and four women aged 18 to 46 after a two-day operation targeting social-media sales of forged tickets and related money laundering.
body: Police said on Thursday they had arrested 10 people in a two-day operation against the sale of fake concert tickets and associated money laundering. The suspects, six men and four women aged 18 to 46, were detained on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud, obtaining property by deception and money laundering. Some had triad backgrounds, police said.

Investigators from Sau Mau Ping Police District carried out the operation, codenamed IMMENSEWAVES, on Tuesday and Wednesday after analysing closed-circuit television footage and the flow of funds through mule accounts. Those accounts had handled more than HK$81 million in suspected crime proceeds linked to at least 12 separate cases involving losses exceeding HK$360,000, police said.

Chief Inspector Chung Man-ning described the syndicate as organised and systematic. Members would post advertisements on social media one or two days before an event, offering tickets at half price with no deposit and promising face-to-face handover. Couriers then met buyers at MTR stations, sometimes demonstrating a ticket check, took cash or a transfer to a mule account, and disappeared. Online posts were deleted immediately afterwards.

Senior Inspector Yiu Kong-kuen said the seized fake tickets were highly realistic and difficult to detect with the naked eye during a brief exchange. Genuine tickets have smoother paper, clearer printing, a reflective laser sticker and fluorescent ink visible under ultraviolet light, he said. Police advised the public to buy only through official channels and to avoid social-media resale offers.

zh.headline: 警方破獲假門票集團拘10人 傭儡戶口處理逾8100萬元
zh.dek: 秀茂坪警區展開「瀚濤」行動，拘6男4女，年齢18至46歲，涉嫌串謀詐騙、以欺騙手段取得財產及洗黑錢。
body: 警方周四表示，已拘10人，打擊網上演唱會及大型活動假門票銷售及相關洗黑錢活動。被捕人士包括6男4女，年齡介乎18至46歲，涉嫌串謀詐騙、以欺騙手段取得財產及洗黑錢，部分人有三合會背景。
秀茂坪警區人員於周二及周三展開代號「瀚濤」的行動，經分析閉路電視片段及傭儡戶口資金流向後採取行動。警方指，涉案傭儡戶口合共處理超過8100萬港元懷疑犯罪得益，牽涉至少12宗不同類型騙案，騙款超過36萬港元。
總督察鍾曼寧形容集團組織有系統。骨幹成員會在活動前一兩日於社交平台發布帖文，以半價促銷、毋須落訂及可面對面交收作招俠。交收人員當日在港鐵站與買家會面，甚至示範驗票，收取現金或轉帳後即逃去無蹤，並即時刪除網上帖文。
高級督察姚剛權指，檢獲的假門票仿真度高，短暫交收時難以憑肉眼察覺。真票紙質較滑、印刷清晰，右上方有反光雷射貼紙，背面有紫外光下才顯現的螢光墨水。警方呼籲市民只透過官方渠道購票，切勿相信社交平台轉售帖文。
